title: All AI-generated code should be Open Source
summary:
The article advocates for all AI-generated code to be Open Source, presenting two core arguments.

First, it highlights that AI models are trained extensively on publicly available Open Source code and content from platforms like Stack Overflow, which carry Creative Commons licenses requiring attribution. This training data was often scraped without permission, making the act of turning code derived from this open knowledge into proprietary, closed-source software feel like "license laundering."

Second, the author argues that purely AI-generated code should not be copyrightable because it lacks human authorship. Citing the US "Monkey Selfie" dispute and U.S. Copyright Office guidance, the article states that non-humans cannot hold copyrights, leading Wikimedia Commons to mandate AI-generated images as Public Domain. While acknowledging global variations in copyright law, the author proposes that to ensure fairness and honor the open ecosystem that enabled AI, developers should explicitly release AI-generated code under Open Source licenses or dedicate it to the public domain via CC0.

The article concludes that code created with minimal human intervention, where developers primarily provide prompts without significant review or modification of the output, should unequivocally be Open Source.
chinese_title: 所有人工智能生成的代码都应该开源
chinese_summary:
本文主张所有人工智能生成的代码都应开源，并提出了两个核心论点。

首先，文章强调AI模型在大量公开可用的开源代码以及Stack Overflow等平台的内容上进行训练，这些内容带有要求署名的知识共享许可。这些训练数据通常未经许可抓取，因此将源自这些开放知识的代码转化为专有、闭源软件的行为，感觉就像是“许可证洗钱”。

其次，作者认为纯粹由AI生成的代码不应享有著作权，因为它缺乏人类创作性。文章引用了美国“猴子自拍”争议和美国版权局的指导意见，指出非人类不能拥有著作权，这促使维基共享资源将AI生成的图像强制规定为公共领域内容。尽管承认全球版权法的差异，作者提议，为了确保公平并尊重促成AI发展的开放生态系统，开发者应明确将AI生成的代码以开源许可发布，或通过CC0许可将其贡献给公共领域。

文章总结道，在人类干预最少的情况下创建的代码——即开发者主要提供提示，而对输出结果没有进行大量审查或修改的代码——应毫无疑问地开源。

title: Many of Amazon’s Black Friday and Cyber Monday “deals” offered no savings
summary: An investigation by Groundwork revealed that many of Amazon's Black Friday and Cyber Monday "deals" provided no actual savings to consumers. The study, conducted by November 2026, found that nearly one-third of advertised "deals" offered no price reduction. Furthermore, almost 10% of these promotional offers were actually more expensive than their regular prices, indicating that shoppers were often misled rather than saving money.
chinese_title: 亚马逊黑色星期五和网络星期一的许多“优惠”并未带来任何节省。
chinese_summary: Groundwork的一项调查显示，亚马逊黑色星期五和网络星期一的许多“优惠”并未给消费者带来实际节省。这项截至2026年11月完成的研究发现，近三分之一的广告“优惠”并未降价。此外，这些促销优惠中近10%的商品实际上比其常规价格更高，这表明消费者常常被误导，而非省钱。

title: How to make almost anything
summary:
The document details the "How to Make (almost) Anything" (HTMAA) course for 2026, identified by MAS.863/4.140/6.9020. Classes run Wednesdays from 1:00-4:00 at E14-633, with most recitations on Thursdays from 5:00-6:00.

The extensive curriculum, spanning September to December, covers foundational and advanced topics in digital fabrication and physical computing. Key modules include computer-aided design (CAD), computer-controlled cutting and machining (CAM), 3D scanning and printing, and parametric design. The course deeply explores embedded programming, electronics design and production (including EDA and debugging), input/output devices, motor/motion control, mechanical/machine design, and machine building. It also touches on modern concepts like AI agents and Edge AI, networking, communications, interface programming, and molding/casting.

The semester includes first and second project reviews. It concludes with final assignments, dedicated project development, a presentation on December 15th, a final exam, and an open house. The course also references application details, personnel, and prior years' content.

chinese_summary:

该课程内容广泛，从九月持续到十二月，涵盖了数字制造和物理计算的基础及高级主题。主要模块包括计算机辅助设计 (CAD)、计算机控制切割与加工 (CAM)、3D扫描与打印，以及参数化设计。课程深入探讨了嵌入式编程、电子设计与生产（包括EDA和调试）、输入/输出设备、电机/运动控制、机械/机器设计以及机器制造。课程还涉及AI代理和边缘AI、网络、通信、接口编程以及模具/铸造等现代概念。

本学期包括第一次和第二次项目评审。课程最后包括期末作业、专注的项目开发、12月15日的演示、期末考试和一个开放日。课程还参考了申请详情、相关人员以及往年的课程内容。

title: Technical issue at JPMorgan Chase triggers online banking delays for US banks
summary:
A technical issue at JPMorgan Chase's data center on Friday, October 27, 2023, caused widespread online banking and payment processing delays for numerous U.S. banks, including Chase itself, Wells Fargo, Truist, and U.S. Bank.

The problem stemmed from a hardware failure at a single JPMorgan Chase data center, which processes payments for its own customers and other banks. This led to disruptions in services like online transfers, Zelle payments, and certain direct deposits. While Chase stated its systems were recovering throughout the day and the issue was resolved by Friday evening, many customers reported continued delays into Saturday, with some payments taking longer to process.

Chase apologized for the inconvenience, clarifying that customer accounts and balances remained secure and the issue was not a cyberattack. The incident highlighted the interconnectedness of the U.S. financial system and the cascading impact a single point of failure at a major institution can have across the industry.
chinese_title: 摩根大通技术故障，引发美国多家银行网银服务延迟
chinese_summary:
2023年10月27日星期五，摩根大通数据中心发生技术问题，导致包括大通银行、富国银行、Truist银行和美国银行在内的多家美国银行出现大范围网上银行和支付处理延迟。

问题源于摩根大通的一个数据中心发生硬件故障，该中心负责处理其自身客户及其他银行的支付业务。这导致网上转账、Zelle支付和某些直接存款等服务中断。尽管大通银行表示其系统全天都在恢复，并且问题已于周五晚间解决，但许多客户报告延迟一直持续到周六，部分支付处理时间更长。

大通银行就此不便致歉，并澄清客户账户和余额仍然安全，且该问题并非网络攻击。此次事件凸显了美国金融系统的互联互通性，以及一家主要机构的单一故障点可能对整个行业造成的连锁影响。

title: Microsoft 365 outage leads to chlorine gas poisoning of 15 hotel guests
summary:
An IT outage affecting Microsoft 365 services, including Outlook, led to a chlorine accident at Phantasialand's Hotel Ling Bao in Brühl. Due to the disruption, the theme park failed to receive critical alarm emails from its automated pool maintenance system, which had detected a malfunction causing excessive chlorine to be pumped into the pool.

As a result, 15 hotel guests suffered injuries, predominantly respiratory irritations, after visiting the pool. Initially, four guests were hospitalized, with one person remaining for observation due to a moderate injury. Emergency services confirmed the significantly elevated chlorine levels, leading to the temporary closure and subsequent reopening of the pool after the water was replaced.

The incident prompted other hotel operators, like Max Wiesen of "Mauritius Hotel und Therme," to review their own safety protocols, highlighting the importance of robust monitoring. Cybersecurity architect Stephan Skrobisch emphasized that Microsoft was not to blame, arguing instead that Phantasialand should have implemented additional warning mechanisms, such as acoustic signals, for critical safety systems, rather than solely relying on email notifications.

title: Universal XSS in uBlock Origin from website-driven element picker
summary:
A critical one-click universal XSS vulnerability was discovered in uBlock Origin (MV2 Firefox version), allowing a malicious website to inject arbitrary JavaScript into any other site. The issue, primarily identified by GPT-5.6 Sol, stemmed from the extension's element picker functionality.

The attack involved four key steps:
1.  **Leaking the Extension UUID:** A malicious website could hook `XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open` to intercept an internal XHR request made by a uBlock Origin filter (`no-fetch-if`). Triggering this filter (e.g., by `fetch('/adsbygoogle.js')`) would expose the extension's unique `moz-extension://<UUID>` path.
2.  **Embedding the Element Picker:** With the UUID, the attacker created an invisible iframe, setting its `src` to `moz-extension://${UUID}/web_accessible_resources/epicker-ui.html`.
3.  **Driving Filter Injection:** The attacker then used `postMessage` to communicate with the embedded picker iframe. By manipulating the `opt` field (normally for filter types like `$image`) with a newline, they could bypass restrictions and inject an arbitrary trusted scriptlet filter, such as `"image\ngoogle.com##+js(trusted-rpnt, script, ...)"`.
4.  **User Interaction:** The attacker would then position the invisible iframe to align with the element picker's "Create" button, tricking the user into clicking it and thereby confirming the malicious filter.

Since filters added by the element picker are treated as trusted, the injected scriptlet could execute arbitrary JavaScript on any target website. The vulnerability has since been fixed, notably by requiring a secret password for communication with the element picker iframe.

title: What's Next for Nvidia?
summary:
Nvidia faces a critical juncture following the resignation of its visionary co-founder and CEO, Jensen Huang. The article warns that companies often struggle after such a departure, with innovation dying as execution-focused leaders replace entrepreneurial founders. Huang uniquely reinvented Nvidia three times—pivoting from graphics chips to a software platform (CUDA), then to deep learning, and finally to integrated AI datacenter systems—demonstrating radical business model shifts.

Drawing parallels with Microsoft under Steve Ballmer (who missed key market shifts like mobile and cloud) and Apple under Tim Cook (who delivered incremental improvements and stumbled on new major products), the article argues that execution-only CEOs often lead companies to miss future opportunities. Nvidia's major customers are now becoming competitors, building their own AI chips, directly threatening Jensen's innovation-driven strategy.

The board confronts four key challenges: deciding whether to remain an innovative, risk-taking company or focus on core execution; finding a successor (an innovator vs. an executor, given Huang’s centralized style and lack of succession planning); replacing Huang as the company's brand and diplomat amidst geopolitical challenges; and overcoming the natural risk aversion of large corporations in a rapidly changing market.

While Nvidia's current momentum (order book, CUDA) offers short-term stability, the board must choose between hiring for current business execution or for future reinvention, understanding that "execution pays your salary, innovation pays your pension."
chinese_title: 英伟达何去何从？
chinese_summary:
黄仁勋这位富有远见的联合创始人兼首席执行官辞职后，英伟达正面临一个关键的转折点。文章警告说，此类离职后，公司往往会陷入困境，随着注重执行的领导者取代具有创业精神的创始人，创新会随之消亡。黄仁勋曾三次独特地重塑英伟达——从图形芯片转向软件平台（CUDA），接着转向深度学习，最后转向集成式AI数据中心系统——展示了激进的商业模式转变。

文章将此与史蒂夫·鲍尔默（他错过了移动和云计算等关键市场转变）领导下的微软以及蒂姆·库克（他带来了渐进式改进，但在新的主要产品上屡屡碰壁）领导下的苹果进行类比，认为仅专注于执行的CEO常常导致公司错失未来的机遇。英伟达的主要客户现在正在成为竞争对手，他们正在构建自己的AI芯片，直接威胁着黄仁勋以创新为导向的战略。

董事会面临四个关键挑战：决定是继续保持一家创新、敢于冒险的公司，还是专注于核心执行；寻找一位继任者（鉴于黄仁勋的集权式风格和缺乏继任计划，选择创新者还是执行者）；在全球地缘政治挑战中，取代黄仁勋作为公司的品牌和外交官的角色；以及克服大公司在快速变化市场中固有的风险规避倾向。

尽管英伟达目前的势头（订单储备、CUDA）提供了短期稳定性，但董事会必须在为当前业务执行招聘人才和为未来重塑招聘人才之间做出选择，并认识到“执行力支付你的工资，创新力支付你的养老金。”
